title: Rank Portability Does Not Imply Feasibility Portability: Target-Specific Evaluation of Joint Hardware Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.22122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-device hardware evaluation often assumes that if architecture rankings transfer across devices, a proxy device can support target-side model selection. We stress-test this assumption for joint latency-energy feasibility across two public architecture families. On NAS-Bench-201, cross-device rank correlations are moderate, while target-comparable feasible-set overlap remains incomplete. A faithful AdaProxy diagnostic substantially improves latency ranking, showing that the observed boundary failures are not simply due to weak adaptation. Exact finite-sample split-conformal analysis also exposes an evidence bottleneck: a finite one-sided 90% threshold requires at least nine calibration observations. We then replicate the phenomenon on 10,000 GPT architectures across 13 HW-GPT-Bench devices. Relative to an RTX3080 proxy, target latency SRCC ranges from 0.951 to 0.996, yet proxy-reuse violation risk ranges from 33.3% to 100% under matc

translated_title: 排名可移植性并不意味着可行性可移植性：联合硬件约束的目标设备特定评估
translated_abstract: 跨设备硬件评估通常假设：只要架构排名能够在不同设备之间迁移，代理设备就可以支持目标端的模型选择。我们对这一假设进行了压力测试，考察了两个公开架构家族上延迟-能耗的联合可行性。在 NAS-Bench-201 上，跨设备排名相关性仅为中等水平，而与目标设备可比的可行集重叠并不完整。一个忠实的 AdaProxy 诊断显著改善了延迟排名，这表明所观察到的边界失效并非仅仅源于适配能力不足。精确的有限样本分割共形分析还揭示了一个证据瓶颈：要得到有限的单侧 90% 阈值，至少需要九个校准观测值。随后，我们在 13 台 HW-GPT-Bench 设备上的 10,000 个 GPT 架构上复现了这一现象。相对于 RTX3080 代理设备，目标延迟的 SRCC 范围为 0.951 至 0.996，然而在匹配条件下，代理复用导致的可行性违规风险却高达 33.3% 至 100%。
tldr: 论文通过 NAS-Bench-201 和 HW-GPT-Bench 上的实验证明，即使架构在设备间的延迟排名相关性很高（SRCC 达 0.951–0.996），基于代理设备的延迟-能耗联合可行性判断仍会产生 33.3%–100% 的违规风险，因此排名可移植性不能替代针对目标设备的可行性评估。
en_tdlr: Rank portability across devices does not imply feasibility portability: even with high latency rank correlations (SRCC 0.951–0.996), proxy-based joint latency-energy feasibility evaluation incurs 33.3%–100% violation risk, so hardware-constrained assessment must be target-specific.
